sentences.zh: 我记得我们猛踩刹车，掉头绕行，直奔达拉斯/沃思堡国际机场，成为了最早到达的那批人之一。

sentences.en: We're sitting with some of the families that are outside waiting for their family members to come in.
sentences.zh: 我们和一些在外面等待亲人进来的家庭坐在一起。

sentences.en: And this is all kind of happening, it feels like, in slow motion.
sentences.zh: 这一切都在发生，感觉就像是在慢动作中进行。

sentences.en: Because we worked with refugees and immigrants, because we were in that community, we know people from these places.
sentences.zh: 因为我们曾与难民和移民合作，因为我们身处那个社区，我们认识来自这些地方的人。

sentences.en: These are people that we love and we know.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们爱的人，我们认识的人。

sentences.en: So that felt like such a threat to freedom.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉是对自由的巨大威胁。

sentences.en: Tess really had an awakening that night.
sentences.zh: 泰丝那天真的觉醒了。

sentences.en: She starts reading more.
sentences.zh: 她开始阅读更多书籍。

sentences.en: She starts getting more vocal.
sentences.zh: 她开始变得更有表达欲。

sentences.en: And then just about a year later,
sentences.zh: 然后大约一年后，

sentences.en: Persons who violate the law of our nation are subject to prosecution.
sentences.zh: 违反我国法律的人将受到起诉。

sentences.en: The family separation policy breaks.
sentences.zh: 家庭分离政策打破了。

sentences.en: If you violate the law, you subject yourself to prosecution.
sentences.zh: 如果你违法，你就要承担被起诉的后果。

sentences.en: And I would cite the Apostle Paul and his clear and wise command in Romans 13 to obey the laws of the government because God has ordained the government for His purposes.
sentences.zh: 我想引用使徒保罗在罗马书第13章中清晰而明智的命令，即服从政府的法律，因为上帝为了祂的旨意设立了政府。

sentences.en: To kind of defend why they were separating families at the border, he used Scripture.
sentences.zh: 为了替他们在边境分离家庭的做法辩护，他引用了圣经。

sentences.en: I remember watching that and yelling at the TV, because in some ways it was earth-shattering, like, don't do that.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时看着那一幕，冲着电视大喊，因为在某种程度上这太令人震撼了，就像是，别这么做。

sentences.en: Be raciSt. Be whatever you're being, but don't use Scripture to back it up and defend it.
sentences.zh: 去做个种族主义者吧。做你任何正在做的事，但不要用圣经来支撑和辩护。

sentences.en: Like, don't, in my opinion, defame God in that way.
sentences.zh: 就像，在我看来，不要那样玷污上帝。

sentences.en: Has it felt like you need to choose between your faith and your political beliefs?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得需要在你的信仰和政治信念之间做出选择？

sentences.en: I think in 2016, maybe I would have said yes to that question because I was feeling that way, which maybe is why I didn't vote.
sentences.zh: 我想在2016年，我可能会对这个问题说“是”，因为我当时有那种感觉，这也许就是我当时没有投票的原因。

sentences.en: Like, I had to make a choice.
sentences.zh: 就像，我必须做出选择。

sentences.en: But I think the more I understand who Jesus is, my faith informs my politics.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，我对耶稣了解得越多，我的信仰就越能指引我的政治立场。

sentences.en: This is the reason I'm voting the way I am now, is because of my faith.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我现在要这样投票的原因，一切都是因为我的信仰。

sentences.en: Well, it's been two years since Tess really struggled with what to do in 2016, and now she's not hesitating at all.
sentences.zh: 嗯，距离泰丝在2016年纠结该如何是好已经过去两年了，现在她一点也没有犹豫。

sentences.en: Casting my vote for a Democrat for the very first time,
sentences.zh: 生平第一次将选票投给民主党人，

sentences.en: I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: Elizabeth, how did you end up focusing on Tess and women like her?
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，你是怎么开始关注泰丝和像她一样的女性的？

sentences.en: I cover religion and politics.
sentences.zh: 我报道宗教和政治。

sentences.en: And so ahead of the midterms, one of the big questions for me was what are evangelical voters going to do, especially after they supported President
sentences.zh: 所以在中期选举之前，对我来说最大的问题之一是福音派选民会怎么做，尤其是他们在2016年以如此庞大的数量支持了总统

sentences.en: Trump in such great numbers in 2016.
sentences.zh: 特朗普之后。

sentences.en: So of course, the majority of white evangelicals are Republican.
sentences.zh: 所以当然，大多数白人福音派都是共和党人。

sentences.en: I mean, they've gotten what they wanted so far from President Trump in terms of policy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在政策方面，他们到目前为止已经从特朗普总统那里得到了他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Trump's approval rating among white evangelical women has been quietly dropping.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，特朗普在白人福音派女性中的支持率一直在悄然下降。

sentences.en: So the question is, how many Tess's are there?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，有多少个像泰丝这样的人？

sentences.en: And what really is the reach of this bubbling resistance?
sentences.zh: 这种正在萌芽的抵抗力量到底有多大的影响力？

sentences.en: What impact will it have on Election Day?
sentences.zh: 它会对选举日产生什么影响？

sentences.en: So why focus the question on Texas?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么要将问题聚焦于得克萨斯州呢？

sentences.en: Beto O'Rourke is happening in Texas.
sentences.zh: 贝托·奥鲁克正在得克萨斯州参选。

sentences.en: We have this very tight Senate race that's highly watched.
sentences.zh: 我们迎来了这场备受瞩目的、非常激烈的参议院竞选。

sentences.en: It's one of the most anticipated races.
sentences.zh: 这是最受期待的竞选之一。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And you're running against Ted Cruz.
sentences.zh: 而你的竞选对手是特德·克鲁兹。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, now Ted Cruz, we know, is very disliked.
sentences.zh: 那么，现在特德·克鲁兹，我们知道，非常惹人厌。

sentences.en: Let me read some quotes.
sentences.zh: 让我读几句引言。

sentences.en: Al Franken said, I like Ted Cruz more than most of my other colleagues like Ted Cruz, and I hate Ted Cruz.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·弗兰肯说，我喜欢特德·克鲁兹的程度超过了我的大多数其他同僚喜欢特德·克鲁兹的程度，而我恨特德·克鲁兹。

sentences.en: Lindsey Graham, if you killed Ted Cruz on the floor of the Senate, nobody would convict you.
sentences.zh: 林赛·格雷厄姆说，如果你在参议院大厅里杀死了特德·克鲁兹，没人会定你的罪。

sentences.en: On one side, you have Senator Ted Cruz.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你有参议员特德·克鲁兹。

sentences.en: Religious liberty has been a foundational passion of mine for decades, and I have a long record of standing and defending religious liberty and winning success.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，宗教自由一直是我的一大基本热情，我有着长期捍卫宗教自由并取得成功的记录。

sentences.en: Who has made evangelicals the bedrock of his support in the paSt. He is, of course, courting them.
sentences.zh: 他过去曾让福音派成为他支持的基础。他当然在拉拢他们。

sentences.en: Whether it was defending the Ten Commandments monument on the state capitol grounds, or defending the Pledge of Allegiance, the words, one nation under God.
sentences.zh: 无论是捍卫州议会大厦广场上的十诫纪念碑，还是捍卫效忠誓词，即“在上帝之下的一个国家”这几个字。

sentences.en: But Beto O'Rourke is courting them, too, and he's doing it pretty quietly, I think.
sentences.zh: 但贝托·奥鲁克也在拉拢他们，而且我觉得他做得相当低调。

sentences.en: For the Republicans who are here today in Richardson, who have joined us in this room, you're in the right place.
sentences.zh: 对于今天来到理查森、加入我们这个房间的共和党人来说，你们来对地方了。

sentences.en: So for a lot of people who don't really like Ted Cruz,
sentences.zh: 因此，对于许多并不真的喜欢特德·克鲁兹的人来说，

sentences.en: they see someone like Beto really spending time on reaching more broadly to communities that the Democratic Party might have rejected in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他们看到像贝托这样的人花时间更广泛地接触民主党过去可能拒绝的群体。

sentences.en: How tight is this Senate race in Texas?
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州的这场参议院竞选有多激烈？

sentences.en: It is not as tight as Beto O'Rourke and Democrats would like.
sentences.zh: 它不像贝托·奥鲁克和民主党人希望的那样激烈。

sentences.en: Our latest CNN polling showing Ted Cruz with a comfy lead over O'Rourke.
sentences.zh: 我们最新的CNN民调显示，特德·克鲁兹对奥鲁克保持着舒适的领先优势。

sentences.en: So to me, I would say, look, Cruz is the favorite.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我会说，看，克鲁兹是更被看好的一方。

sentences.en: O'Rourke still has a shot of winning.
sentences.zh: 奥鲁克仍有一线获胜的机会。

sentences.en: But Texas is still Texas.
sentences.zh: 但得克萨斯州终究是得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: And Cruz is most likely going to pull out the victory.
sentences.zh: 而克鲁兹极有可能会赢得胜利。

sentences.en: So I went to Texas because I wanted to see how evangelical women were responding to this dynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了得克萨斯州，因为我想看看福音派女性对这种动态有何反应。

sentences.en: Hey, my name is Sarah Dama.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我叫莎拉·达马。

sentences.en: I'm Emily Mooney.
sentences.zh: 我是艾米丽·穆尼。

sentences.en: My name is Sarah Bailey.
sentences.zh: 我叫莎拉·贝利。

sentences.en: And starting with George W.
sentences.zh: 从乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush, I voted a straight Republican ticket.
sentences.zh: 布什开始，我一直投全票共和党。

sentences.en: At first, I voted Republican because it's what I saw my evangelical community doing.
sentences.zh: 起初，我投票给共和党，因为我看到我的福音派社区就是这么做的。

sentences.en: So I go and I meet with Tess.
sentences.zh: 所以我去见了泰丝。

sentences.en: And I also met with several other young evangelical moms like her.
sentences.zh: 我还见了几位像她一样的年轻福音派妈妈。

sentences.en: Because I'm a Christian, honestly, it didn't even occur to me to vote in any other way.
sentences.zh: 因为我是基督徒，老实说，我甚至没想过用任何其他方式投票。

sentences.en: They're all very pro-life.
sentences.zh: 她们都非常支持生命权。

sentences.en: They oppose abortion.
sentences.zh: 她们反对堕胎。

sentences.en: I think there should be increased legal restrictions around elective abortions.
sentences.zh: 我认为应该围绕选择性堕胎增加法律限制。

sentences.en: But they've all had these experiences in the past couple of years, especially about immigration.
sentences.zh: 但她们在过去几年里都有过这些经历，特别是在移民问题上。

sentences.en: The Jesus commanded me to love the immigrant, to love the voiceless, and just to champion them.
sentences.zh: 耶稣命令我要爱移民，爱无声者，并为他们仗义执言。

sentences.en: And so the Jesus that I see in the New Testament is deeply concerned about the dignity of all people.
sentences.zh: 因此，我在新约中看到的耶稣对所有人的尊严都深表关切。

sentences.en: So this doesn't mean that I care about the unborn any less, because I also care about other issues.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不意味着我对未出生婴儿的关心减少了，因为我也关心其他问题。

sentences.en: We don't lead single-issue lives.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活不是单一议题的。

sentences.en: It wasn't that they're no longer pro-life when it comes to abortion.
sentences.zh: 并不是说在堕胎问题上她们不再支持生命权了。

sentences.en: It's that they have these other competing ideas about what that identity, that pro-life identity means, especially when it comes to immigration and race.
sentences.zh: 而是她们对于这种身份、那种反堕胎身份意味着什么，有了其他相互冲突的想法，尤其是在涉及移民和种族问题时。

sentences.en: And how do you reconcile the issue of abortion with your newfound beliefs?
sentences.zh: 你如何将堕胎问题与你新发现的信仰协调起来？

sentences.en: I know that no candidate or no senator is going to be perfect.
sentences.zh: 我知道没有哪个候选人或参议员是完美的。

sentences.en: I know that no one is going to necessarily line up with everything I believe.
sentences.zh: 我知道没有人会完全符合我的所有信念。

sentences.en: I feel like being pro-life is being pro-all life, from the Syrian person who's fleeing bombs in their country,
sentences.zh: 我觉得支持生命就是支持所有的生命，从逃避国内炸弹的叙利亚人，

sentences.en: to the Honduran immigrant, to the child separated at the border, to the kid in foster care, to the baby in the mother's womb.
sentences.zh: 到洪都拉斯移民，到在边境失散的儿童，到寄养系统中的孩子，再到母亲子宫里的婴儿。

sentences.en: Like, if I am pro-life, I'm looking at all of that life.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果我支持生命，我就会关注所有这些生命。

sentences.en: You're listening to Janet Neffert Live on American Family Radio.
sentences.zh: 您正在收看美国家庭广播电台的珍妮·内弗特直播节目。

sentences.en: All right, I can't wait to get into this.
sentences.zh: 好的，我迫不及待地想深入探讨这个话题了。

sentences.en: The New York Times put out a story yesterday.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》昨天发表了一篇报道。

sentences.en: Beto O'Rourke may benefit from an unlikely support group, White Evangelical Women.
sentences.zh: 贝托·奥鲁克可能会受益于一个意想不到的支持群体：白人福音派女性。

sentences.en: This is the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 这是《纽约时报》的报道。

sentences.en: It's based in Dallas.
sentences.zh: 它总部设在达拉斯。

sentences.en: We published the story, and almost immediately, I was shocked by the volume of response that this piece started to get.
sentences.zh: 我们发表了这篇报道，几乎立刻，这篇稿件引发的大量反响就让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a quote from a woman named Tess Clark.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是引用一位名叫泰丝·克拉克的女人的话。

sentences.en: I care as much about babies at the border as I do about babies in the womb.
sentences.zh: 我对边境婴儿的关心不亚于对子宫里婴儿的关心。

sentences.en: We've been asleep.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都在沉睡。

sentences.en: Now we've woke up.
sentences.zh: 现在我们醒了。

sentences.en: Ms. Clark, who sells candy.
sentences.zh: 克拉克女士，她以卖糖果为生。

sentences.en: What's the worst reaction you've gotten?
sentences.zh: 你得到的最大恶评是什么？

sentences.en: That I'm not a Christian.
sentences.zh: 说我不是基督徒。

sentences.en: That I'm a baby killer.
sentences.zh: 说我是杀婴者。

sentences.en: There's no way any woman with a real relationship with Jesus could ever vote for a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 一个与耶稣真正建立关系的女人绝不可能投票给民主党。

sentences.en: Maybe I should vote for Beto.
sentences.zh: 也许我应该投给贝托。

sentences.en: Well, why would you vote for Beto?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你为什么要投给贝托？

sentences.en: You know, this whole thing about he hits a stark moral contrast to Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于他与特朗普形成鲜明道德对比的整个说法。

sentences.en: Give me a break.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.en: I was...
sentences.zh: 我当时……

sentences.en: And on the other hand, you have other women coming up to Tess and her friends at church whispering in their ear saying,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，有其他女性走到教堂里的泰丝和她的朋友们身边，在她们耳边低声说，

sentences.en: wow, I'm going to vote for Beto too, and I haven't told my husband, and I feel like I'm going against my pastor.
sentences.zh: 哇，我也要投给贝托，我还没告诉丈夫，我觉得我违背了牧师的意愿。

sentences.en: And how did you prepare your family for the fact that you would be featured in this article?
sentences.zh: 你如何为你的家人做好心理准备，让他们知道你将成为这篇文章的主角？

sentences.en: You know, I texted my mom and dad and said, hey, I just wanted you guys to know I'm going to be in an article in the New York Times, which my dad replies, fake news.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我给爸爸妈妈发短信说，嘿，我只是想让你们知道，我要上《纽约时报》的一篇文章了，我爸回复说，假新闻。

sentences.en: And then I texted back and I was like, oh, come on, dad.
sentences.zh: 然后我回信说，噢，拜托，爸爸。

sentences.en: It won't be fake news because it's going to be, you know, my story along with other women.
sentences.zh: 这不会是假新闻，因为你知道，这将是我的故事以及其他女性的故事。

sentences.en: And he just wrote back, go Trump, go Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 他只是回信说，支持特朗普，支持卡瓦诺。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: That was kind of the text back.
sentences.zh: 短信交流差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And my dad to this day has not read the article.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我爸爸也没有读过这篇文章。

sentences.en: I reached out to him a couple of days ago.
sentences.zh: 几天前我联系了他。

sentences.en: I was like, do you remember the article I did for the New York Times?
sentences.zh: 我说，你还记得我为《纽约时报》写的文章吗？

sentences.en: Well, I remember you said something about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得你提过一些。

sentences.en: I was like, did you read it?
sentences.zh: 我说，你读了吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't read it.
sentences.zh: 不，我没读。

sentences.en: And he said, well, too bad you're on the wrong side here.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，真遗憾，你这次站错了队。

sentences.en: So you kind of joke with each other about it.
sentences.zh: 所以你们会拿这个开开玩笑。

sentences.en: Yeah, kind of make it light a little bit.
sentences.zh: 对，稍微轻松一点处理。

sentences.en: But there's definitely that disconnect there between us where we can't go deeper than that.
sentences.zh: 但我们之间确实存在那种脱节，无法进行更深入的交流。

sentences.en: What does it mean to you that he hasn't read the article?
sentences.zh: 他没有读这篇文章，对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: You know, it's in those moments where you're kind of thinking, no matter how old you get, you want to feel connected to your parents.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正是在那些时刻，你会想，无论你多大年龄，你都想和父母保持联系。

sentences.en: You want your parents to be proud of you.
sentences.zh: 你希望父母为你感到骄傲。

sentences.en: You know, I'm 35 and my husband's 40 and we were having this conversation the other day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我35岁，我丈夫40岁，我们前几天还在聊这个话题。

sentences.en: You never stop wanting the approval of your mom and your dad.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会停止对爸爸妈妈认可的渴望。

sentences.en: It's interesting to me that when you think about the history of evangelicals as part of this so-called moral majority,
sentences.zh: 在我看来很有意思的是，当你想到福音派作为所谓道德多数派的历史时，

sentences.en: the Tess's out there are not saying that they want to leave the Republican Party because they don't believe that abortion is a moral issue anymore.
sentences.zh: 那些像泰丝一样的人并不是说她们想离开共和党，是因为她们不再相信堕胎是一个道德问题。

sentences.en: They have moral objections to the rest of the Republican platform.
sentences.zh: 她们对共和党纲领的其余部分有着道德上的异议。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And for many of their parents, for whom that moral majority generation defined their adulthood,
sentences.zh: 对于她们的许多父母来说，那个道德多数派的一代定义了他们的成年期，

sentences.en: that seems to be really threatening for them, that their children and the future of the evangelical movement
sentences.zh: 这似乎对他们构成了真正的威胁，因为他们的孩子和福音派运动的未来

sentences.en: is questioning everything that they had established on these very moral grounds.

sentences.en: Or, I mean, I know I only had a couple of lines in the article, but, you know, I hadn't got to talk to you really that much about my trip to the border.

sentences.zh: 我在文章里稍微提了一下，我只是想知道你对那次旅行或者我所见所闻有没有什么问题。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, I mean, I would like to know what you personally saw, because, you know, I haven't personally witnessed anything.

sentences.en: I mean, what we know is what we see, hear, and read.

sentences.en: So, I mean, what is your personal...
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，你个人的……

sentences.en: Yeah, so when I went to the border, one of the places we went was to Ursuline, where they were actually doing the physical family separations.
sentences.zh: 对，所以我去边境时，去的一个地方是乌尔苏林，他们实际上在那里进行物理上的家庭分离。

sentences.en: And then we went to ICE, and we got to meet some of the people who were there.
sentences.zh: 然后我们去了移民及海关执法局（ICE），还见到了那里的一些工作人员。

sentences.en: And one of the women that I met, she was telling me how a year ago she had been deported during a raid in her community, and her daughters had witnessed her being deported.
sentences.zh: 我见到的其中一位女性告诉我，一年前她在她社区的一次突袭中被驱逐出境了，她的女儿们目睹了她被驱逐的过程。

sentences.en: She lived in the United States since she was 14.
sentences.zh: 她从14岁起就住在美国了。

sentences.en: And after she was deported, a few months later, her older daughter, who was about nine at the time, I believe, tried to commit suicide.
sentences.zh: 在她被驱逐后几个月，我想当时大概九岁的大女儿试图自杀。

sentences.en: So, Juana said, I knew that I was risking everything by trying to cross back into the United States,
sentences.zh: 所以，胡安娜说，我知道试图重新越境回美国会让我冒着一切风险，

sentences.en: but I had to get to my daughter for her to know that even if I got caught, I tried to get to her.
sentences.zh: 但我必须找到我女儿，让她知道即使我被抓了，我也努力去见她了。

sentences.en: And I think as a mother, you know, like, that resonated with me so much, thinking about if that was me, I would do that, too.
sentences.zh: 我想作为一个母亲，你知道的，这深深地引发了我的共鸣，一想到如果换作是我，我也会这么做。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, you know, that's certainly an isolated case.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这当然是一个孤立的案例。

sentences.en: I mean, of course, who wouldn't be sympathetic and compassionate, personally experienced, but, I mean, not every case is like that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然，亲身经历了谁会不同情、没有同情心呢，但是，我的意思是，并非每个案例都这样。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't feel like everybody that's crossing that border is doing it for what they're claiming.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得并不是每个越境的人都像他们声称的那样。

sentences.en: I mean, they're the ones putting themselves in this position, coming over here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是他们自己把自己置于这种境地，来到这里的。

sentences.en: They're not all being persecuted.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是都在遭受迫害。

sentences.en: I mean, what would you like to see them do?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你希望看到他们怎么做？

sentences.en: You're talking about these, you know, fences and, you know, cages.
sentences.zh: 你在说这些，你知道的，栅栏，还有，你知道的，笼子。

sentences.en: I mean, this is all temporary stuff.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这都只是些临时措施。

sentences.en: I'm not sure what the answer is, but you've got to contain them to some degree.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定答案是什么，但你在某种程度上必须控制住他们。

sentences.en: But it feels like the human piece is missing for me with the current administration and the current policies, and that's what I'm upset about.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得现届政府和现在的政策缺少了人情味，这正是我感到难过的地方。

sentences.en: I think we have to restructure them.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要重组它们。

sentences.en: I mean, do you honestly think that this country can just continuously let people, especially, I mean, it's not nowhere near Trump's fault.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你真的认为这个国家可以不断地让人进来吗，尤其是，我的意思是，这跟特朗普一点关系也没有。

sentences.en: I'm saying that people are being treated like criminals that are coming to claim asylum when that's not a criminal offense.
sentences.zh: 我是说那些来申请庇护的人被当作罪犯对待，而这根本不是刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: Because it's a lie, Tess.
sentences.zh: 因为这是谎言，苔丝（Tess）。

sentences.en: They're not being persecuted.

sentences.en: We know, and you know.

sentences.en: How do we know that they're not?

sentences.en: How do we know?

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.

sentences.en: Really?

sentences.en: You know, why are you coming?

sentences.zh: 我们想要更好的生活。

sentences.en: I mean, it didn't say, hey, you know, I was being punished, and, you know, you're picking isolated cases.

sentences.en: I don't know.

sentences.en: It just feels like, is there not a more human approach we can take?
sentences.zh: 只是觉得，难道我们就不能采取一种更有同情心的方法吗？

sentences.en: I'm trying to lean in and think about this from more of like a Christian worldview and going, okay,
sentences.zh: 我正试着深入并从更偏向基督教的世界观来思考这个问题，然后想，好吧，

sentences.en: Jesus called us to welcome the foreigner and the stranger and treat them as if they were among your family.
sentences.zh: 耶稣呼召我们去欢迎外国人和陌生人，把他们当作你们的家人一样对待。

sentences.en: And then it even says you could be entertaining angels when you're doing this.
sentences.zh: 然后它甚至说，当你这样做的时候，你可能是在款待天使。

sentences.en: And Jesus could have come to earth as anything that he wanted to, right, as any powerful person, as a king, as a prince.
sentences.zh: 而且耶稣本可以以他想要的任何身份来到世上，对吧，以任何强者的身份，作为一个国王，作为一个王子。

sentences.en: We all know that, yeah.

sentences.en: But he came as a baby in a poor home that ended up having to leave their country to seek refuge somewhere else.

sentences.en: I don't disagree with that.
sentences.zh: 我不否认这一点。

sentences.en: But we are not world saviors.
sentences.zh: 但我们不是世界救世主。

sentences.en: This can't continue to happen.
sentences.zh: 这种情况不能再继续下去了。

sentences.en: This won't be a country anymore.

sentences.zh: 你知道的，特朗普其实不是那种坏人，你知道的，不是这里的坏人。

sentences.zh: 我希望那不是真的。

sentences.zh: 我希望我能相信我们的总统不是个坏人。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对我和我来说也是非常黑暗的一天。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, not that it's right, but it's for a good reason because all the terrorist act that was against this country.

sentences.en: I don't know who's committed all these school shootings that are acts of terror.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是谁犯下了所有这些作为恐怖行为的校园枪击案。

sentences.en: White people.
sentences.zh: 白人。

sentences.en: I just don't see how anybody could support the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我只是不明白怎么会有人支持民主党。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm even confirmed even more through this Judge Kavanaugh ordeal that there's no way I would support the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，经过这次卡瓦诺法官的风波，我更加确信我绝不可能支持民主党。

sentences.zh: 大家都亲眼目睹了发生的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I don't like that either.

sentences.en: Well, he definitely allowed it, because God is sovereign.

sentences.en: I do believe that.
sentences.zh: 我确实相信这一点。

sentences.en: God also allowed Pharaoh to rule, and then he liberated his people from him.
sentences.zh: 上帝也曾允许法老统治，然后他把自己的百姓从法老手中解放出来。

sentences.en: I just think at the root of our faith, it feels like you have the Christianity of empire, and you have the Christianity of the vulnerable.

sentences.en: And it feels like that's where everyone is so split, is that some people who are both professing faith, who are both reading the same Bible, who both say,

sentences.en: I'm a follower of Jesus, are coming out on the other side of this in completely different camps, with completely different thoughts.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在末日到来之前将会有大量的苦难降临。

sentences.en: I mean, the end times are coming when Jesus is going to rule and reign on this earth again.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，末日即将来临，届时耶稣将再次在这片大地上掌权执政。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not going to get any better the closer it gets to the end.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，越接近末日，情况只会越糟糕。

sentences.en: I mean, it tells you in the Bible that the closer you get to the Lord, the more you're going to be persecuted.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，圣经里告诉你，你越接近主，你受到的迫害就会越多。

sentences.en: Well, maybe that migrant caravan, they're really close to the Lord.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许那个移民大篷车队，他们真的离主很近呢。

sentences.en: They're knocking them praying all the way here.
sentences.zh: 他们一路过来都在祈祷。

sentences.en: I feel like they probably have a lot to teach us about, say.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们或许有很多关于信仰的东西可以教给我们。

sentences.en: They're followers of Jesus, too.
sentences.zh: 他们也是耶稣的追随者。

sentences.en: How are they not?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么能不是呢？

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, God doesn't love any of us any different.
sentences.zh: 比如，上帝爱我们每一个人都是一样的。

sentences.en: Well, that for me is why I've changed the way that I'm voting in the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 好吧，对我来说，这就是为什么我改变了期中选举投票方式的原因。

sentences.en: You really think that you're voting in that Democrats?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为你在投民主党的票吗？

sentences.en: So you're telling me you're voting for Cruz.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说你要投克鲁兹（Cruz）的票。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: You're not going to change my mind about Cruz.
sentences.zh: 你休想改变我对克鲁兹的看法。

sentences.en: O'Rourke is just not on my mind.
sentences.zh: 奥鲁克（O'Rourke）根本不在我的考虑范围内。

sentences.en: And I hate that because, I mean, he may be a better candidate.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌这样，因为，我的意思是，他可能是个更好的候选人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We're landing in different places.
sentences.zh: 我们在不同的立场上找到了归宿。

sentences.en: We share the same faith.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有相同的信仰。

sentences.en: And we still both want good things for the country and for people.
sentences.zh: 而且我们俩仍然都希望国家和人民一切都好。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of people who aren't even willing to sit down for the conversation.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多人甚至不愿意坐下来谈一谈。

sentences.en: So I'm just glad that you did that with me and that I got to hear more about kind of how you're feeling and what you're thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴你能和我这样交流，让我能更多地了解你的感受和想法。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I do feel very proud of you.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我确实为你感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: I'm very proud of you.
sentences.zh: 我为你感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: And also, you're parenting.
sentences.zh: 而且，你也在带孩子。

sentences.en: Don't always agree on how to handle them children, but I'm still proud of you.
sentences.zh: 虽然对如何管教那些孩子并不总是意见一致，但我依然为你感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Thank you, Dad.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，爸爸。

sentences.en: Thanks for talking with me today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你今天和我聊天。

sentences.en: It means a lot.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: Well, anytime.
sentences.zh: 行吧，随时都可以。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Love you.
sentences.zh: 爱你。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: I want to bring your attention to something that you might not know about because I think it just came out.
sentences.zh: 我想提醒你注意一件你可能不知道的事，因为我觉得它刚出来不久。

sentences.en: The Georgia Secretary of State's office, that's your opponent, Brian Kemp,
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州务卿办公室，也就是你的竞选对手布赖恩·坎普，

sentences.en: they've just announced they've opened an investigation into the Democratic Party of Georgia for possible alleged cyber crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚宣布对佐治亚州民主党涉嫌网络犯罪展开调查。

sentences.en: On Sunday, just two days before the election, Georgia's Secretary of State, Brian Kemp, who is also the Republican nominee for governor,
sentences.zh: 周日，也就是选举前两天，佐治亚州务卿布赖恩·坎普（他同时也是共和党州长候选人），

sentences.en: said he was investigating the state's Democratic Party for allegedly trying to hack into the voter registration system.
sentences.zh: 表示他正在调查该州民主党人涉嫌企图黑入选民登记系统。

sentences.en: Have you heard anything about this?
sentences.zh: 你听到这方面的消息了吗？

sentences.en: Kemp, who faces Democrat Stacey Abrams tomorrow in a tight race, and who has been accused of repeatedly trying to suppress Democratic votes in his role as Secretary of State,
sentences.zh: 坎普明天将在激烈的选战中迎战民主党人斯泰西·艾布拉姆斯，且他此前在担任州务卿期间曾被指控屡次试图压制民主党选票，

sentences.en: offered no evidence to back up the allegation.
sentences.zh: 他没有提供任何证据来支撑这一指控。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Abrams was asked about the claim by CNN's Jake Tapper.
sentences.zh: 周日，美国有线电视新闻网的杰克·塔珀就这一说法询问了艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: He is desperate to turn the conversation away from his failures, from his refusal to honor his commitments,
sentences.zh: 他极力想要转移人们的视线，不再关注他的失职、他拒绝兑现承诺，

sentences.en: and from the fact that he is part of a nationwide system of voter suppression that will not work in this election.
sentences.zh: 以及他是一场全国性压制选民系统的一部分这一事实，而这在本次选举中是行不通的。

sentences.zh: 《每日简报》就到这里。
